fullContent:
Rajanyadi Churna 
 Reference: Ashtanga hridaya, Sutrasthana 2/37-40 
 Introduction 
 Rajanyadi Churna is a classical Ayurvedic formulation known for its effectiveness in balancing Vata and Pitta doshas . Traditionally used in pediatric care, this herbal blend is beneficial in managing conditions such as diarrhea, fever, jaundice, and anemia in children. Enriched with Turmeric (Curcuma longa) as a key ingredient, Rajanyadi Churna supports digestion, strengthens immunity, and promotes overall wellness. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g of each of fine powders of:- 
 
 Turmeric ( Curcuma longa ) 
 Daru ( Cedrus deodara ) 
 Sarala ( Pinus roxburghii ) 
 Shreyasi ( Piper chaba ) 
 Brihati ( Solanum indicum ) 
 Kantakari ( Solanum xanthocarpum ) 
 Prishnaparni ( Uraria picta ) 
 Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Each ingredient in the amount of 10gm. is ground to powder form separately and then these powders are mixed together to form Rajanyadi Churna. 
 Keep it in a dry place stored in an airtight container. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 1-3 grams along with honey and rice washed water, 1-2 times a day before or after meals or as suggested by doctor. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Rajanyadi Churna is a useful general tonic powder for children. 
 It is good for treating gastrointestinal tract disorders like diarrhea digestion, in children. 
 Also effective in treating Sprue and vomiting. 
 Effective remedy in fever, jaundice, anemia, asthma, cough and cold. 
 Improves strength, immunity, Weakness and skin quality. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 Over-dosage of this medicine may lead to constipation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
